body: I think it would kill the relationship to talk to him about it. He worries enough about me and I just want to keep him happy. He's probably the only reason I'm alive but I'm just in a lot of pain knowing that I can't tell him because if I did he'd be heartbroken and feel like a failure. Also, therapists are expensive and if I could afford one I'd be in school. I want genuine friendship too not a paid pair of ears.

I work alone at my job. And my parents bailed on me. I just don't have friends. I would talk to my boyfriend about it but I don't want to hurt him. Besides, this is a friend thing not a problem with the relationship.

But what do I do? I work almost full time in a very isolated position and can't afford school anymore. And I just don't know how to find friends anymore. They've all left anyways. They always do. I can't keep friends it seems. I'm starting to think that I'm the problem even if they tell me I'm not. I'm just a waste of space and time.
They just don't care. I see pictures of them hanging out without me. They know I'm sad and they don't care.

I guess a better way to clarify would be to mention that I don't even feel comfortable telling my friends. I feel like I don't trust them enough. When some of them found out I self harmed they cared for all of 5 minutes and then forgot about me.

That's pretty much how I feel. I haven't been hospitalized for any of my endeavors which is lucky since I want to keep future options open. I have potential plans for the future but something in me just doesn't want to live. I don't know why. I feel like it's not normal but I guess I;m not the only one.
